description: This Java source file defines an abstract class HonoSampler for use with JMeter, providing methods for configuring server options, managing semaphore counts, and defining endpoint types within the Hono JMeter testing framework.

classes.name: HonoSampler
classes.description: An abstract JMeter sampler class for Hono, managing server configuration and semaphore counts, with endpoint type enumeration.

classes.name: HonoSampler.Endpoint
classes.description: Enumeration for endpoint types: telemetry and event.

methods.name: modifyServerOptions
methods.description: Applies server options from UI panel to internal properties.

methods.name: configureServerOptions
methods.description: Configures UI panel with current server properties.

methods.name: getTrustStorePath
methods.description: Retrieves the trust store path property.

methods.name: setTrustStorePath
methods.description: Sets the trust store path property.

methods.name: getPortAsInt
methods.description: Returns the port as an integer, defaulting to 0 on parse failure.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Constructs and returns the address string combining endpoint and tenant.

methods.name: addSemaphore
methods.description: Increments semaphore count for the current address, synchronized.

methods.name: getSemaphores
methods.description: Retrieves current semaphore count for the address, synchronized.

methods.name: removeSemaphores
methods.description: Resets semaphore count to zero for the current address, synchronized.
